The '''Administration Building''' was located in [[Tasariq City]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tasariq]]. The building was used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] as their command center, and also by the various interstellar corporations operating on Tasariq. As a result, the Administration Building housed most non-military organizations on the planet.<ref name="J15" />
